title: Accept cash for in-person payments up to $500 (supermarkets)
what: A supermarket retailer must give consumers a reasonable opportunity to pay in cash for in-person payments of $500 or less during the hours the Code sets.

laws.title: Competition and Consumer (Industry Codes—Cash Acceptance) Regulations 2025

sources.title: Competition and Consumer (Industry Codes—Cash Acceptance) Regulations 2025
sources.quote: 12 Accepting cash payments (1) A supermarket retailer must ensure that a consumer who is to make an in-person payment at a retail site of the retailer has a reasonable opportunity to do so by way of a cash payment if: (a) the amount of the payment is $500 or less;

reach.condition: if it is a supermarket retailer covered by the Code
